title: Using overseas work experience for RPL in Australia
metaTitle: Overseas Work Experience for RPL in Australia
metaDescription: Can overseas experience count for RPL? What evidence to use, how translations work and what RPL can't do for a visa. A plain-English guide.
excerpt: Yes, experience from overseas can count towards RPL. Here's the evidence to gather, how translations work and what RPL can't replace.

faqs.q: Does overseas work experience count for RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if it is relevant to the qualification and you can prove it. Assessors look at what you can do and whether your evidence is valid, sufficient, authentic and current, not where you gained the experience.

faqs.q: Do my documents need to be translated?
faqs.a: Documents not in English usually need an English translation. Some training organisations accept a professional translation and others require a certified one, so ask before you pay.

faqs.q: Can I get a licence in Australia using overseas experience and RPL?
faqs.a: A qualification can be a step towards a licence, but licences are issued by state regulators who set their own requirements. Check with the regulator for your trade.

faqs.q: Is RPL the same as a skills assessment for a visa?
faqs.a: No. A skills assessment for migration is done by the assessing authority for your occupation. RPL with a training organisation is separate, so check visa requirements with a registered migration agent.

title: Becoming a trainer and assessor: TAE40122 through RPL
metaTitle: TAE40122 Through RPL: Trainer & Assessor Guide
metaDescription: How to get the TAE40122 Certificate IV in Training and Assessment through RPL: who qualifies, what evidence you need and how assessment works.
excerpt: If you already train or assess people at work, you may be able to get the TAE40122 through RPL. Here's who qualifies and what evidence to collect.

faqs.q: Can I get the TAE40122 through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you already design, deliver or assess training and can show it with evidence such as session plans, recordings and assessment records.

faqs.q: Do I need to deliver a session for RPL?
faqs.a: Usually yes. The qualification includes practical delivery and assessment, so expect to deliver or assess a live or recorded session.

faqs.q: Can I teach a trade with only the TAE40122?
faqs.a: No. You also need the vocational competence and current industry skills for what you teach, usually shown by holding the qualification you deliver.

faqs.q: Is the TAE40122 the current qualification?
faqs.a: Yes. It replaced the TAE40116, and RTOs are expected to use the current version.

title: Security licence and RPL: what to check in your state
metaTitle: Security Licence & RPL: What to Check First
metaDescription: Security licences are issued by state regulators and some restrict RPL. Learn how qualifications and licences differ and what to confirm first.
excerpt: A security licence comes from your state regulator, and some limit RPL. Here's how qualifications and licences fit together and what to check first.

faqs.q: Does a security qualification give me a licence?
faqs.a: No. Qualifications come from a registered training organisation and licences come from your state or territory regulator, which has its own requirements.

faqs.q: Can I use RPL for security licence training?
faqs.a: It depends on the state and the licence class. Some regulators restrict RPL, so confirm with the regulator or us before you enrol.

faqs.q: What evidence can security officers use for RPL?
faqs.a: A current or previous licence, a statement of service, de-identified incident reports and patrol logs, and first aid certificates. Supervisors can add rosters and risk assessments.

faqs.q: Which qualification do I need for a master security licence?
faqs.a: Some states require a management-level qualification such as the Certificate IV in Security and Management. Requirements differ, so check your regulator.

title: RPL for aged care, disability and community services workers
metaTitle: RPL for Aged Care & Community Services Workers
metaDescription: Turn care work experience into a Certificate III or higher through RPL. Qualifications, evidence and screening checks for community services.
excerpt: Working in aged care, disability, childcare or community services? Here's how RPL can turn that experience into a qualification.

faqs.q: Can I get a Certificate III in Individual Support through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you have worked in aged care, disability or home care and can show evidence of your duties, training and workplace skills.

faqs.q: What evidence do care workers need?
faqs.a: A reference or statement of service, position description, training certificates, de-identified shift notes, and any screening checks you hold.

faqs.q: Do I need an NDIS Worker Screening Check?
faqs.a: Workers in risk-assessed roles with NDIS-registered providers need one. It is a screening requirement, separate from your qualification.

faqs.q: Does RPL cover work placement hours?
faqs.a: Often your existing work can cover placement, but the training organisation decides what it accepts. We confirm this at your eligibility check.

title: Mechanic RPL: get your automotive trade certificate
metaTitle: Mechanic RPL: Automotive Trade Certificate Guide
metaDescription: Experienced mechanic with no certificate? Learn how RPL can give you a Certificate III or IV in automotive, what evidence to use and state licensing.
excerpt: Worked as a mechanic without a trade certificate? Here's how RPL can recognise your skills with a Certificate III or IV in automotive.

faqs.q: Can I get a mechanic's certificate through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you have enough hands-on experience and can show it with photos, job cards and a reference. A practical assessment is usually part of it.

faqs.q: Do I need a licence to work as a mechanic?
faqs.a: Most states do not license individual mechanics, but some regulate repairers. For example NSW and Western Australia have schemes that look for a Certificate III.

faqs.q: Do I need a separate licence for air conditioning?
faqs.a: Handling vehicle air conditioning refrigerant needs an ARC licence, which is separate from your trade qualification.

faqs.q: Can I use overseas trade certificates?
faqs.a: Yes, they can be used as evidence, translated if needed, alongside photos, job cards and a reference.
